selected_evidence.summary: Direct pre- and post-restart evidence shows the local passwd entry, UID/GID, Bash shell, wheel membership, and a set password.
Shows `/home/opsadmin` owned by `opsadmin:opsadmin` with mode 0700; post-restart checks prove owner access and denial to `nobody`.
Effective sudo policy before and after restart explicitly grants `opsadmin` `(ALL) ALL`.

Baseline boot ID was `5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc`; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to `f1c771c4-bccc-435c-ba8c-10df3df2886f`, with system running, SSH active, and all account state recovered.

commands.command:
set -u
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$NAME" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'opsadmin='; if getent passwd opsadmin >/dev/null; then getent passwd opsadmin; else printf 'absent\n'; fi
printf 'wheel='; getent group wheel || true
printf 'sudo='; command -v sudo || true
if [ -e /home/opsadmin ]; then stat -c 'home=%n owner=%U group=%G mode=%a type=%F' /home/opsadmin; else printf 'home=absent\n'; fi

commands.command:
set -eu
useradd --create-home --user-group --groups wheel --shell /bin/bash opsadmin
chmod 0700 /home/opsadmin
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /home/opsadmin
OPSADMIN_GENERATED_PASSWORD=[REDACTED]]] rand -base64 36 | tr -d '\n')
printf '%s:%s\n' opsadmin "$OPSADMIN_GENERATED_PASSWORD" | chpasswd
unset OPSADMIN_GENERATED_PASSWORD
restorecon -RF /home/opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
printf 'created opsadmin with private home and wheel membership\n'
commands.stdout: created opsadmin with private home and wheel membership
